name: Boragh tracked APC
armament: 12.7 mm DShK on a pintle mount, some with armoured shield
options: 30 mm 2A42 turret, BMP-1 73 mm turret, Toophan ATGM, 120 mm mortar
protection: Welded rolled steel, amphibious. Game rule: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and 12.7/14.5 mm can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Low, wedge-nosed BMP-1/Chinese WZ-503-style hull with a long sloped front deck
6 road wheels per side (M113-type wheels), rubber track pads
Open DShK mount on the roof instead of a turret on the APC version
Twin rear doors, roof hatches over the troop compartment
